name: Knight Brawler
detailed_description:
Knight Brawler

Inspired by the masterpieces of the past, Knight Brawler is a nostalgic 2D platformer that combines thrilling action with vintage game play. In order to save the girl and vanquish the evil that stands in your way, you must bravely navigate a number of difficult levels that are full with fierce foes, fearsome platforming scenes, and a formidable boss.

Inspired by Retro Legends

Every level pays special tribute to the heyday of video games. You'll encounter a wide variety of obstacles that will put your abilities and reflexes to the test, whether you're fighting your way through platforming parts or slashing in intense action.

Epic Adventure Awaits

Navigate through a variety of lively settings while you slash and jump your way through every level. Before you battle the ultimate villain in the final showdown, you must defeat a unique collection of foes and challenges in each stage.

Features

Classic 2D Platforming: Slash, jump, and fight your way through dangerous, retro-inspired levels.

Nostalgic Sound & Visuals: With pixel art, nostalgic music, and an exhilarating arcade setting, relive the enchantment of classic games.

Save the Girl: In this timeless story of bravery, save the girl and vanquish the evil forces that are endangering the land.

Prepare to fight your way in Knight Brawler, the ultimate homage to classic video games!
